summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, a social hub, lore destinations and a solo tutorial. Shared player behaviors and place simulations compose authored and generated spaces; quests, encounters and gear build progression, while player saves separately hold homes, arcade records and timed smoothie effects.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, routes, landmarks, Christmas Area and stair anomalies.

places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with simulated staff, shops, directory, arcade island and payphones; now includes playable Block Panic and Squeeze Play smoothie counter; Rico's Bonus Line remains separate.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route; HALOGEN handoff seeds Dina's lead.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, level2, level02, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; Dina's freight/handoff/return records are here.

places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10, level26, level27 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and deeper destinations; Level 5 guest rooms/suites are permanent player homes and Level 26 hosts SS Fun.
places/level11 (3D) - Infinite City with generated street grid/subway and authored street furniture; sim adds Spamton's alley, city cast and destinations.

places/level12, places/level13, places/testlab, places/spamton (3D) - Matrix-to-Boiling-Frogs destinations, Floor 283, and authored test/bonus spaces; places/level184 is another standalone simulated destination.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings; config also selects shared lighting.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival, tutorial and Dina quest ticking/routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - composed player HUD/menus and character status panel; imports arcade and smoothie overlays.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout, Christmas Area and stair-anomaly seeding.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 house, crew exit, basement grid/collapse and Fresh Paint.
places/level5/sim.js + scripts/l5-resident.js + scripts/build.js; mods/lagscope/mod.json + watch.js + panel.js - Level 5 room/home restoration and optional performance inspector.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names, destinations and door/model proximity-preload manifest.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout; thresholds/sign geometry shared by participating places.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; dialogue.js/dlg-*.yml author NPC conversations and npc-starters.js supplies quest/realty choices.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, shifting partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall material, damage, drops, wrecking and regrowth; place sims opt in with sweepProps/tickWalls.

scripts/lib/data/cow-lines.yml + art/vo/act.py + scripts/lib/data/voice-cast.yml/voice-acted.yml + voices.js - named performers and recorded takes for NPC bark/dialogue consumers; dlg-quest-main.yml records main-quest source lines.
scripts/lib/data/smoothies.yml - Squeeze Play fruit, recipe, price, timed-effect and Sal voice data; scripts/smoothie-player.js and smoothie-ui.js consume it.
notableExports: scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - layXmas, stillLook; scripts/lib/maze.js - XMAS_CELL and maze cell/zone helpers; scripts/xmas-geo.js - geometry(ctx); scripts/xmas-still.js - update(ctx).
scripts/lib/musicbox.js - MB, MB_LOOP, MB_WIND, MB_BODY, kneel, placeMusicBox, musicNear; scripts/musicbox.js - update, ears.
scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - cat appearance/morph exports; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - shared NPC appearance/refitting exports.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe, MEAT, CASH and money; shared item tokens feed interaction, loot UI and player inventory.

scripts/door-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold geometry/material builders; scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - wallPose, layMoments.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack; scripts/lib/voices.js - voiceKey, actedVoice, vo.
scripts/lib/breakables.js - shared breakable/wall helpers; scripts/lib/sign-style.js - restyleSigns; scripts/lib/stats.js - weapon class/damage/handling/requirement helpers.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - questVoice, HOME, CAMP, dinaLead, setDinaStep, dinaTick; scripts/arcade.js - ears.press; scripts/smoothie.js - ears.press; scripts/smoothie-player.js - onInput, update, sCutPour, sCutReveal, sCutEnd.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position, tapes, currency and homeKeep build buckets; car IDs in player.state.cars.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js advances dinaQ and owns dinaDiary/dcut/dinaLead plus migration from the-undelivered to the-way-back.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - player.state.remodQ, l02got, l02paint, fresh, capnAsk and capnFailed plus Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation.
scripts/build.js + places/level5/sim.js - player homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built; home11 and booked Level 5 room buckets reconstruct separately.
scripts/l5-resident.js + places/level5/sim.js - player l5room/l5home/l5until/l5key booking identity and place.state.l5rent permanent exclusive-room ledger; there is no checkout path.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js own kick cooldowns and carry/held target session; scripts/lib/loose.js + breakables.js own loose prop/wreck and breakable state.

Enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget; scripts/lib/meg-agent.js keeps gunpoint reaction memory/dialogue/pose on NPCs; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances; scripts/lib/l7-tiny.js owns Tiny hunt state.

scripts/arcade-play.js owns each player's player.state.arcade session/score view and persistent arcadeBest; board/inputs live in player.session. scripts/smoothie-player.js owns smoothieOpen/smix/smoothieBook/smoothieBuff/sCut and spends player.state.cents.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors; arcade-play.js and smoothie-player.js are in the player behavior chain.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js zone names.
world.config.yaml input actions bind kick H/L and reload R; handlers in player/combat behaviors consume action names.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; Bonus Line boarding is separate.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time.

tutorial0 HALOGEN cut completion → scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js dinaLead and scripts/lib/dina-quest.js; diary/cutscene and clue records across Level 26, Level 1, Level 3 and Gamma advance player.state.dinaQ and play recorded voices.

scripts/build.js permits building only inside home11 or permanently booked Level 5 room; placement/removal writes homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built, and Level 5 sim restores saved pieces and keeps NPCs/creatures outside per-room ownership.
scripts/l5-resident.js booking → player l5home/l5room and place.state.l5rent permanent ledger; resident booking assigns room/trunk ownership; no checkout action is offered.
scripts/player.js reload inputs → session.later queue → laterTick on player update clock → reloadStep/reloadMagIn/reloadDone/pumpRack; reloadTok/equipped checks reject stale scheduled steps.

usable bc-cab-4 press → scripts/arcade.js ears.press sets player.state.arcade; scripts/arcade-play.js consumes movement/jump/interact and updates session.ap + arcadeBest → scripts/arcade-ui.js draws Block Panic overlay; E leaves.

usable bc-juicebar press → scripts/smoothie.js opens per-player mixer; smoothie-ui.js sends smoothie actions → smoothie-player.js validates 2-3 fruits, charges cents, records discoveries and runs Sal cutscene; timed player.state.smoothieBuff heals/feeds during active play → stats-ui.js status panel.
Bonus Room Tom's diner purchases → scripts/hub.js sets temporary hubFood/hand model; diner meals/drinks are free and hubFood is cleared on leaving the mall.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored mall shops/props and simulated staff; arcade island's bc-cab-4 runs Block Panic through arcade.js/arcade-play.js, while Squeeze Play uses recipe data, recorded Sal voice and timed buffs; Rico's platform/Bonus Line remains separate.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow; home11 and Level 5 use separate saved buckets.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration; Fort Surrender uses tagged paired leaves.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station; places/level02/sim.js + l02-grid.js vary partitions/lights/crew/knocks/reset.
scripts/lib/meg-agent.js - per-NPC nerve/stats/weapon-driven reactions, aim, cover and recorded gunpoint barks; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances across Level 7, Bonus and Level 0.2.
Level 13: level13-furnish.js + level13.yml vary flat furnishing/story; level13-dress.js + l13-dress.yml lay hall traces/doors; foe, people and tape layers define encounters/residents/salvage.

Weapon family: weapons.yml + throwables.yml vary requirements/stats/loot; stats.js maps class/skill shortfall to handling, while weapon-look.js/fp-gun.js/vmpose.js provide visual and first-person variants.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV and door transfers' local #-marked xferTo/carryId rules; Level 3 hatchV=3 rebuilds l3-hatch-* deterministically.

Level 0.2 sim V=25 rebuilds generated roots; preserve phase/caseLandAt and debris tags, plus the 15-second empty reset. Grid state remains place.state.l02grid={layout, lamps}; walls swap on six-second passes with view/near/lamp exclusions.

Christmas Area scripts/lib/data/xmas.yml v=9 re-lays xmas-prefixed objects; keep maze.js XMAS_CELL and xmas.yml cell/bounds aligned (bounds suppress Level 0 hum); retain player.state baubles/stuffing for craft recipes. Breakables use breakables.yml material tuning and shared wreck/regrowth records.

Dina quest stages remain in player.state.dinaQ for saves; keep legacy the-undelivered migration, the-way-back quest ID, and record min-stage gates aligned with clue setDinaStep stages and exact recorded q-dina/q-clerk lines.

Level 5 building uses homeKeep.l5built keyed by persistent placed IDs; l5home and l5rent's 9e15 ledger mark a permanent exclusive room, and homesBack rebuilds missing pieces—do not conflate this with homeKeep.built.

Arcade board/runtime lives in player.session.ap while arcadeBest and the displayed arcade session are on player.state. Smoothie recipes store total/left in seconds of active-play ticks, not wall-clock time; preserve smoothieBuff fields and status display in stats-ui.js.
